{{Quote|I know we'll be together again. It's just a matter of time.|Mallatobuck|<ref name="Chewbacca 1">[[Chewbacca (2000) 1|''Chewbacca'' (2000) 1]]</ref>}}
'''Mallatobuck''' (meaning "beautiful singer" in [[Shyriiwook/Legends|Shyriiwook]]<ref name="GCG">''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>), also known as '''Malla''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] from [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. She was the wife of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and mother of their son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]]. Malla had a brother named [[Vargi]].

==Biography==
===First acquaintance===
[[File:Mallatobuck_Comic_1.jpg|thumb|left|180px|A younger Mallatobuck.]]
Malla first met [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] when they were adolescents. She saw him for the first time as he made what she referred to as ''"&hellip;a reckless, show-off jump from a Wroshyr tree, made over a needlessly long distance, flirting with death, and an utterly childish thing to do"''. Chewbacca's jump was quite impressive, and right then at that moment, she knew Chewbacca had to be hers. However, she was too nervous to admit her feelings for him. To get Chewbacca to notice her, Malla turned to Chewbacca's cousin for help. Their first acquaintance was followed by a traditional courtship, though some of their flirtations did not go so well. Later on, they were caught by [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], but Chewbacca confronted these slavers, pulling a few arms off along the way. However, after these events, they maintained only a close friendship.<ref name="Chewbacca 1" />

===Romantic relationship===
Chewbacca was later enslaved by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and only after his rescue by [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his return did his relationship with Malla become more romantically involved. When Chewbacca finally decided he wanted to [[Marriage/Legends|marry]] Malla, an albino Wookiee named [[Tojjevvuk]] also wanted her for himself. Chewbacca killed Tojjevvuk, and his clan placed a death mark on Chewbacca. Mallatobuck and Chewbacca did not finally [[Wedding of Chewbacca and Mallatobuck|marry]] until Tojjevvuk's father called off the death mark.<ref name="Chewbacca 1" />

Following the wedding, Han attempted to leave Chewbacca behind on Kashyyyk, reasoning that Chewie's responsibility to his new wife outweighed a life debt. Malla gave Han a dressing-down for the implied insult to her husband's honor, and bade Chewbacca goodbye.

===Wife and mother===
[[File:Mallatobuck.jpg|thumb|200px|Mallatobuck.]]
Eventually, Malla and Chewbacca had a son named [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]]. However, Malla did not see much of her husband, due to the [[Life debt/Legends|life debt]] he had to Han Solo. Despite this, Chewbacca returned once per year (with Han's blessing) to celebrate [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] with Malla and their son.<ref name="hs" />

In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Malla, as well as her village, was held hostage by [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] commander [[Ozrei N'takkilomandrife|Knife]], who sought to set up a slave trade on Kashyyyk. Unbeknownst to Malla, her brother [[Vargi]] and several defected Wookiees were a part of the operation. Once Chewbacca, Han, and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] were able to break free, the three proceeded to end the operation. With the help of the [[Alliance of Free Planets|Alliance]], the [[Skirmish on Kashyyyk (Nagai invasion)|battle]] ended and all of those who were involved were apprehended. Upset at his involvement and betrayal, Malla disowned Vargi as her brother.<ref name="Star Wars 91">[[Star Wars (1977) 91|''Star Wars'' (1977) 91]]</ref>

She constantly worried about her son's growing desire to be like his father during the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] early years. Because of this, Malla considered letting Lumpy stay with the Solos on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. During a trip to Coruscant with his father, Lumpawarrump was [[Skirmish in the secret Imperial detention center|captured]] while trying to capture [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] that broke into the [[Solos' apartment]]. Lumpawarrump became captured, and Chewbacca and Mallatobuck discovered that the burglars were planning to [[Assassin/Legends|assassinate]] the New Republic's leaders. Determined to stop them, they infiltrated the [[Secret Imperial detention center|enemies' base]] to find an advanced [[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|IT-3 interrogation droid]] named "[[It (IT-3 Interrogator)|It]]" masterminding the plot. The Wookiees rescued their son and foiled the [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] plans. After the incident, Malla decided that Lumpy would be safer on Kashyyyk.<ref name="A Forest Apart">''[[A Forest Apart]]''</ref> While in mourning after Chewbacca's [[Destruction of Sernpidal|death]], Malla agreed to allow Lumpawaroo to assume his father's life debt to Han Solo.

==Skills and abilities==
Malla enjoyed cooking and was known for her meal of [[Bantha rump|bantha surprise]], and her famous [[Wookiee-ookiee]]s. Chewbacca made her a number of crossbows as a gift, handmade by him.<ref name="hs" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Malla_Lumpy.jpg|thumb|150px|Malla on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], carrying a young [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawaroo]].]]
In ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'', Malla was played by [[Mickey Morton]].<ref name="hs" />

One of Malla's notable appearances is in the comic series [[Star Wars: Chewbacca (2000)|''Star Wars: Chewbacca'']], where she is the narrator for the first episode. She tells the story of how she and Chewbacca met and functions as a means to portray the grief over Chewbacca's death.

Both ''[[Star Wars: The Visual Dictionary]]'' and ''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]'' misspell the character's name as "Mala."

[[Stan Winston]] created Malla's facial appearance by altering an original Chewbacca mask from ''A New Hope''.<ref>{{YouTube|video=MNsvzX1bLr0|text=CANTINARCHEOLOGY PART 4 FORTY YEARS OF THE STAR WARS HOLIDAY SPECIAL|channel=@CredibleNerds|name=The Credible Nerds}}</ref> In [[2018]], [[Tom Spina]]'s company [http://www.tomspinadesigns.com Tom Spina Designs] performed a restoration on this mask.<ref>{{WebCite|url=http://www.tomspinadesigns.com/restoration/star-wars-props/star-wars-chewbacca-malla-mask-restoration|text=Star Wars Chewbacca / Malla Mask Restoration|author=Spina, Tom|archivedate=20191127030238}}</ref>
